mutants.label: [control] reorder local staging operations
mutants.why: Appending the event to the local list and applying that same event to the local state are independent staging operations: selection later observes both completed values, and only the explicit append_event call makes anything durable. This holds for the tick paths exercised here; it does not claim safety against process termination between local Python statements.
